Advanced benefits of Ryse Up Creatine
Directions for use: Take 1 serving daily mixed with your favorite pre-or-post workout beverage.

Warning: Ryse Up Creatine Monohydrate is intended only for healthy adults above the age of 18.
Keep out of reach of children.

All individuals should consult a licensed healthcare practitioner before using this product.
Do not use this product if you have been diagnosed with or have a family history of serious illness or hypo/hypertension. Discontinue use and contact a medical doctor immediately if you experience an adverse reaction.
